text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After training, Winning Ticket grabs Biwa Hayahide, insisting we go to a restaurant near the academy.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yum! That's GOOD!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: The portion's so big! The hamburger steak's so juicy! This is what I really wanted to sink my teeth into!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: After full-power practicing, some full-power eating is the best!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Um, Ticket? You should eat more slowly. It won't be "the best" at all if you choke on your food.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Also, you must take care not to overeat. If you gain weight, it will impact your race results.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whoa, really?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hmm… but I still wanna eat lots and lots…
choice_data_list: Let's eat at full power until we feel full!
Let's eat at full power until we feel full!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hmm… but I still wanna eat lots and lots…
choice_data_list: Let's eat at full power until we feel full!
Let's eat at full power until we feel full!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Moderation? Moderate… So, like, how much is moderate?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Well, it might differ a little by person, but generally for food, you could say it's good to stop before you find yourself feeling full.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ahh, I getcha! So…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: It's kinda like the middle between being starved and about to explode! Makes sense!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'm gonna go moderate—at full power!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Dear me… You certainly have a unique way of looking at things.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah! You're totally right! My trainer knows best!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna eat with all my might until I'm about to explode. That'll definitely make me happy!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hmm, interesting… If freedom is the direction you choose, then I'll refrain from interfering.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ticket, I see now that your trainer has a greater capacity than most.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh? I think my trainer eats the same amount of food as any regular person.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I was referring to the capacity to put up with your antics…
